voxel_to_mips — 3D transform op

• Data kinds: voxel → images

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.voxel_to_mips(vol) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.voxel_to_mips(vol); from the registry, ops3d.get("voxel_to_mips"))

Usage

3-D → maximum-intensity projections along the three orthogonal directions. The entry point for applying 2-D methods (e.g. accel's 2-D NCC).

For an input (D,H,W), returns the list [max(axis=0), max(axis=1), max(axis=2)]. The shapes are (H,W) (axis 0=D collapsed), (D,W) (axis 1=H collapsed), (D,H) (axis 2=W collapsed), respectively, dtype float64. Values are the input maxima as they are (not normalised). Negative values pass through too since it is max; a background of density 0 stays 0. There is no shape validation (2-D fails at axis=2, and 4-D or more still runs), so the caller should check the dimensionality. match_mip_2d applies 2D NCC to these 3 images to estimate the 3D position redundantly. For a projection from an arbitrary viewpoint, use render_volume_projection (mode="mip").
